# Quamam (by Ekipa OpenŠola)

> An open-source (FOSS), independent Android client for Slovenian school information systems, built for speed and privacy.

## Overview
- **Official Website:** https://quamam.org
- **Source Code:** https://codeberg.org/OpenSola/Quamam
- **Developer:** Ekipa OpenŠola
- **License:** GNU GPL v3
- **Primary Language:** Slovenian (sl)

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- **Platform:** Android
- **Language & Framework:** Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
- **UI Design:** Material 3 Expressive UI guidelines
- **Privacy:** 100% client-side local data storage with zero external tracking servers.

## Core Features
- **Grades & Timetables:** Quick overview of student grades, automated grade average calculations, and timetable tracking.
- **School Meals:** Built-in integration for viewing and ordering school lunches (compatible with regional providers like Kroky).
- **Communication:** Localized access to school messaging platforms and student groups.

## Project Status & Legal
- **Status:** Active development (closed testing phase).
- **Public Launch:** Scheduled for September 1, 2026.
- **Legal Disclaimer:** Quamam is an independent third-party client. It is not affiliated, sponsored, or endorsed by eŠola d.o.o. (eAsistent) or K-Norma d.o.o. (Kroky). All user data is processed locally at the user's own responsibility.
